description: The popover under the header's model button: a command palette over every model the chat can run, with a search box on top and the models listed under their family's name.

phone.does: A pane over the page under the model button (a chat's, or Meta's), 280 wide, from just under the button down to the top of the bottom bar at most (the keyboard's top while it's up), scrolling past that; a tap outside it or Back closes it. Its search field and each model row are one height (34), the field's icon over the rows' logos
phone.why: The owner: the list shouldn't fill the whole screen on a phone, only the room between the model's name and the bottom bar, with the search row and the model rows aligned

parts.name: search box
parts.shows: A search field at the top of the popover, empty each time it opens, focused at once.

actions.does: Narrows the list live: a row stays if every word typed is found in its name, its value or its family's name (case ignored); the first match is lit
Moves the lit row one step among those shown (kept in view)
Picks the lit row and closes

decisions.said: Increase search row height a little, decrease individual model heigth a little (so that they are aligned)
decisions.rule: Every app's model picker draws its search field and each model row at one height, the field's search icon in line with the rows' logos

parts.name: family heading
parts.shows: A small dim caption over the first model of each family: every model Antigravity runs (antigravity/…, by models.model_program, whatever it's called: Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Claude Opus 5.5) under "Antigravity" (programs.antigravity, schema/icons/models/families.json's programs); any other by schema/icons/models/families.json's names, in its order of matching: Claude, Qwen, Gemma, Gemini, GPT, Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, Phi, Granite, Kimi, GLM, Nemotron, Command, MiniMax, SmolLM, OLMo, InternLM, Yi, Step, Baichuan, Apple; "Other" for one that matches none). Families are listed in the order their first model was given (Claude's models first, then the chat's host's, then others); models keep their given order inside a family. While searching, a heading shows over the first match of each family.

decisions.said: Alos antigravity is eecognised under "Claude" which is pretty terrible; So I CAN see the model but it's got he wrong logo and it is inthe wrong section
decisions.rule: Every app's model picker lists a model by the program that runs it before its name: every model Antigravity runs is under one Antigravity heading with Antigravity's mark (the one its Subscriptions section shows), its Claude- or Gemini-named ones too, never under Claude's or another family's heading or logo; the picked model's logo on the button, and anywhere else a model's logo is drawn, follows the same rule

decisions.said: Yes it should be put under whateveer existing section we have for openai models.
decisions.rule: Every app's model picker puts a Codex model under the GPT heading with OpenAI's mark whatever its name or value ends in (Codex (default model), codex/default included), never under Claude's; Claude's own default model stays under Claude

parts.name: model row
parts.shows: One line: the family's monochrome logo (16 px, schema/icons/models, the family by schema/icons/models/families.json: an Antigravity model's Antigravity's, the Gemini mark; blank space of the same width when the family has none), the model's name (one line, … past 40 characters; its slug as a tooltip: claude-opus-5-5, qwen3:4b; a long-press on the phone; the full name where it is its slug and cut), and at the right a tick on the picked model only. The button's name shows the picked model's slug on hover too. Claude's rows are named as claude lists them ("Opus 5.5"); a provider's model is named alike across hosts and shows once however many hosts have it, told apart by provider/host name only where two models share a name.

actions.does: Picks the model and closes the popover. Same model: nothing happens. Different: the chat switches (set_model on the running claude with a quiet note "model → <name>"); across programs (Claude to Apple/Codex, or another host) the chat restarts or becomes a new conversation ("model → <name>: a new conversation"); in a Bot, across programs, the Bot is rotated (its conversation archived as a past thread, if anything's been said) and carries on afresh on the picked model with the same note; picked mid-turn for a program change, it waits until the turn is over

decisions.said: A Bot's model should be switchable to any model for now; where nothing carries the conversation across, once its log has rotated (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app lets a Bot be switched to any model, of any program: picking another program's model rotates the Bot (its conversation kept as a past thread) and the Bot carries on afresh on that model, its name, memory, tasks and place as they were; never a separate new chat

decisions.said: All models in the mesh should be visible in the model picker, not only the chat's host's; a pick runs on the first provider that has it
decisions.rule: Every app's model picker lists every model in the mesh, each once, wherever it runs; picking one runs it on the first provider that has it (the chat's host's first, then the mesh's in order), and the provider picker beside it lists the other places it runs.

decisions.said: Model names should be compared ignoring case but shown as cased (gpt-oss:20B and gpt-oss:20b were two); later: still two rows in the list though providers merged
decisions.rule: Every app compares models' names ignoring case (providers.same) and lists a model once however its hosts case its name, shown as one of them lists it.

decisions.said: Both 'Opus 5.5' and 'claude-opus-5-5' can appear in the model list (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app lists each model once: a chat's model recorded as an id (claude-opus-5-5) is shown as, and ticks, Claude's own row for it ("Opus 5.5"), never as a row of its own

decisions.said: Model names are formatted one way across the app, the slug shown only on hover: the model dropdown's names match the telemetry section's (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app names a model one way everywhere (providers.model_name on the desktop, modelName on the phone): as its host lists it, else as its id reads by schema/icons/models/families.json's names (claude-opus-4-7 is "Opus 4.7"), else its name to what serves it; its slug (claude-opus-5-5, gpt-5.4-codex) shows only on hover, or a long-press on the phone

decisions.said: On mobile the model dropdown needs icons, Baude model icons need to be centralised like the great SVG centralisation
decisions.rule: Every app's model picker draws each model's family logo from schema/icons/models (the family by schema/icons/models/families.json), the same files on every app

parts.name: empty list
parts.shows: While the search matches nothing, the centred dim text "No models match".

states.name: opens on picked model
states.shows: The picked model's row is lit (Enter would re-pick it); typing starts from the first match

states.name: scrolling
states.shows: List grows to 420 px tall then scrolls, 280 px minimum wide, no horizontal scrollbar

decisions.said: So many models it's confusing: the list should be like the Cmd+K menu, a search bar on top and monotone icons per family, rows the same height across the provider, model, effort and mode dropdowns
decisions.rule: Every app's model picker is a command palette: a search box on top, models under their family's heading with the family's monochrome logo, and its rows the same height as the provider, effort and mode pickers' rows.

decisions.said: Model selector pane on mobile doesn't need to be so long (right now it expands to fill the full screen vertically). Have it just fill the part below the model name and the part above hte bottom bar
decisions.rule: Every app's model picker hangs under the model button and never fills the screen: it is no taller than the room it has below the button (on the phone, down to the top of the bottom bar, or the keyboard's top), at most 420 px on the desktop, scrolling past that
